clues: This startup created Agentless Agent Bench, a 50-task suite stripped of network dependencies to test processor contention.
Its core sandbox product generates $300 million in annual revenue powering isolated execution environments for AI agents.
It recently closed a $750 million funding round led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation.
A hardware partner hand-delivered an Arm-based Vera server directly to this cloud company's San Francisco office.
CEO Erik Bernhardsson stated it cannot port its catalog to Arm overnight, opting to maintain a heterogeneous server fleet.
This cloud infrastructure startup decided to adopt Nvidia Vera CPUs after tests showed 2x agent throughput over x86 chips.
